Let me parse the verifier:

- x0 = mostcolor(I) = 0 (black background).
- x1 = asobject(I) = all cells with values.
- x2 = matcher(first, x0): checks if the color (first element of cell tuple) == 0.
- x3 = flip of that: cells not black.
- x4 = all non-black cells.
- x5 = partition(I) = objects grouped by color (each color's cells).
- x6 = fork(multiply, height, width) = area of object.

Wait, but x4 includes all non-black cells including green. x10 = difference(x4, x9) = non-black cells excluding the green square. So x10 = all the single colored cells (color 9, 5, etc.).

- x11 = apply(initset, x10) = each cell becomes a singleton object.

- x15 = filter singletons that share row or column with green. These are "reachable with straight line".
- x16 = gravitate toward x9.
- x17 = add(center, gravitate) — the point adjacent to green along the line.
- x18 = connect(center(cell), result) — line from cell center to near green.
- x19 = recolor(color of cell, line).
- x20 = merge all lines.
- x21 = paint.
